message: 空まで山盛り

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! Hello there, Mr. President」
Lolotte suddenly pops out of a clothing store and grabs onto me.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I ran into you at the perfect time. Please teach me how to become a delinquent」
Exams are coming up. I was on my way to Inamiya Supermarket to buy some bargain snacks for late-night studying.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... by 'delinquent,' do you mean turning to juvenile delinquency and becoming a bad kid?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, the exact thing where you ruin your lifestyle and fall into depravity!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Starting today, I am going to wear a long, modified skirt and become 'Sukeban O-Rolo.' Menacing rumble, rumble, rumble」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmph... though, they don't sell weird clothes like that anywhere...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I can't believe it. To think you actually admired that kind of thing, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? I don't actually want to become one either, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's just...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I had a fight with a friend, and I haven't been able to make up with them...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My guidebook says that at times like this, turning to delinquency and going bad is the proper path of human morality」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of extreme logic is that!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Master Synn, someone's got a bead on ya」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?」
Before I know it, a red dot of light is swaying on the back of my hand. It's a laser pointer.
The moment I notice it, the dot moves up my arm to my elbow, climbs to my shoulder... w-wait, is it stopped on my head?
I-Is this a message from Riesling? I have to talk Lolotte down and stop her from going bad!
「Waaah, I went through all the trouble of writing a love letter, and it got thrown right back in my face!」
「They could've at least opened the envelope! Why don't they understand how I feel?!」
「Dammit, if it's gonna be like this, I'm going delinquent! I'm gonna eat curry rice while watching a TV special on dung beetles!!」

name: Synn
message: 「He went inside 'Land of Love'...」
「Gyaaaah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why did an explosion just come from the curry shop?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The shopkeeper is a friend of my butler, you see」
「Ugh... guh...! Seeing a child turn to delinquency breaks my heart... *thud*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! If you go delinquent, is this the kind of fate you end up meeting!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, regardless of how you get there, the end result's pretty much the same」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawawa... Whatever should I do?」

name: Synn
message: 「You just need to make up with them」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y♪ That makes sense too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, please teach me how to make up with a friend. *Waku waku waku*」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, that's something you have to think about for yourself」

name: Synn
message: 「Think, think, and think it through... And if you ever need a helping hand, come talk to me anytime. I'll gladly lend you my support」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fuee~, it's so difficult I don't quite understand, but......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I understand. I'll go home and rack my brain over it lots and lots」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the young lady's transportation to me, her butler, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, the sniper rifle's laser pointer is gone」

name: Riesling
message: 「You flatter me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, Mr. President, fare thee well」
Riesling opens the car door and respectfully ushers Lolotte inside.
For just a split second, Riesling glances toward "Land of Love." Before anyone had noticed, the shopkeeper had stepped out under the eaves, and the two exchange a brief nod.

name: Riesling
message: 「'Operation Supermarket Garden' has been successfully executed」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right, the supermarket. I was on my way to Inamiya」
「Gugogogo... gugogogo... pshururu~, mumble mumble... fuhihihi!」

name: Synn
message: 「...What should I do? He's fast asleep right where he collapsed, having a nice dream」

name: Paqy
message: 「For now, write 'Meat' on that guy's forehead」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」
